from xml.dom import minidom
doc = minidom.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
body = doc.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
for i, p in enumerate(body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')):
    runs = p.getElementsByTagName('w:r')
    texts = []
    for r in runs:
        t = r.getElementsByTagName('w:t')
        txt = t[0].firstChild.nodeValue if t and t[0].firstChild else ''
        rPr = r.getElementsByTagName('w:rPr')
        sz = ''
        b = ''
        if rPr:
            s = rPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:sz')
            sz = s[0].getAttribute('w:val') if s else ''
            b = 'B' if rPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:b') else ''
        texts.append(f'[{sz}{b}]{txt}')
    print(i, '||'.join(texts))
" 2>&1 | head -80
